decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet shelf display is a standard format close to the core offer, so it likely meets aspirations, and a large firm has the slack to carry it at little marginal cost.
The pegboard-back shelf display uses existing cardboard production, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger problemistic search.
The quarter-pallet shelf display is a staple of retail promotion and fits the firm's core business, so it likely performs at or above aspiration.
The eighth-pallet display is a common format brands demand for smaller placements, so it should give satisfactory results with low carrying cost.
The wooden pallet lies outside the cardboard core and was exposed to sharp wood cost increases, which makes a shortfall more likely, but large-firm slack probably lets it stay for now.
Physical media retail is in structural decline, so a media-specific display likely falls short of aspirations and prompts search for better uses of the resources.
